assumptions: Timestamps treated as Europe/London local shop time; CSV contains no timezone metadata
Negative voucher lines treated as retail discounts based on their names; three lines total -10.08 GBP
Explicit -PAYOUT supplier entries excluded from retail revenue
Unknown hours remain missing; no verified opening-hours calendar
December 2024 excluded as sparse startup period; final extraction day 15 July 2026 excluded as potentially incomplete
Line_Total assumed monetary GBP retail amount; tax basis not established from export
original_config.forecast_origin: start of target clock hour; all earlier completed observed hours available; fixed training weights

payday.description: Last three and first three calendar days; exploratory monthly payroll proxy, not observed customer payday

extension_config.public_sector_proxy: illustrative last working day of month plus next two days; not verified employer policy
extension_config.description: Upcoming local calendar day forecast issued at its midnight, all previous recorded days available; daily recorded revenue, not verified complete trading-day demand. Frozen training weights.

provenance.origin: 00:00 local target day; daily horizon ends next local midnight, 23/24/25 elapsed hours
provenance.target: sum of recorded net retail lines, unknown within-day completeness
provenance.privacy: derived features exclude customer, receipt, barcode and payment identifiers

payroll_sources.analysis_status: retrospective employer-calendar scenarios; customer employer mix is unobserved

sources.rule: Last working day of each calendar month
sources.historical_application: Document predates the experiment; continuation through 2025-26 is assumed, not independently confirmed

sources.employer: University Hospitals of Leicester resident doctors
sources.rule: 27th, moved to previous banking day for weekends/bank holidays; December is an unspecified exception
sources.historical_application: Current published policy applied retrospectively; historical publication/effective dates unverified; December and potentially affected January spillover remain unknown

sources.rule: Explicit published payment dates, not payroll submission deadlines
sources.historical_application: Exact published calendar covers November 2025 to March 2027 only; earlier months remain unknown
